method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Most of the frame is defocus blur, the mannequin hands at lower left read as a primitive model, and the orange ribbon floats above the table with no contact shadow, so the struggle beat has no finished subject.
notes.fix: Move the camera down and in to a tight crop on two well modelled hands round the mug, and seat the broken ribbon flat on the wood with a contact shadow. Keep only a shallow blur behind it.

notes.problem: The indigo talk ribbons are fixed, but the defocused hands around the blue mug still show lumpy, toe-like fingers at full size. A dark figure sliver cuts the left edge at y 980 to 1280. The indigo ribbons run under the headline's second line.
notes.fix: Crop the hands out below the frame edge so only the mug and a sleeve cuff remain. Remove the left-edge figure. Lower the two indigo ribbons about 120 px so they cross the table under the headline instead of through it.

notes.problem: The kit-figure hands on the mug are still visible lower left, and the broken gold ribbon, the actual subject, is small (about a fifth of the frame) and outshouted by the big blue streak behind it.
notes.fix: Crop in until the gold ribbon and its break span half the frame width at the focal point, and drop the blue ribbon into soft focus or cut it so the gold owns the frame.

notes.problem: The headline sits on a flat blue wash plate whose soft edge cuts across the post tops, the ribbon stops short of the gate, and art_preflight still lists needs_review [9].
notes.fix: Lower the camera so the sky behind the gate is the type's own quiet, drop the wash plate, and run the ribbon to the bottom rail in dusk gold with a contact shadow.

notes.problem: The type wash leaves a boxy edge in the sky at about y 900 to 950, with a lighter halo around the oak. The oak is flat and pasted on. The ribbon is orange-red with a scalloped, broken crest instead of the deck's gold. The ribbon and caliper fill well under half the frame. This frame is unchanged because the rework was reverted.
notes.fix: Lower the camera to ledge height so a polished gold #E0956A ribbon coil and the open caliper fill the bottom half on limestone, with oak-leaf shadows cast across them. Drop the wash and set the headline in open sky above the gate.

notes.problem: Unchanged after the failed rework. The headline wash is a pale-haloed rectangle cutting into the live oak, the skyline is flat cut-outs, and the orange ribbon reads as a serrated centipede, not S1's machined ribbon.
notes.fix: Remove the wash and set the type in the open sky by moving the oak out of the type column to the far right edge, and re-model the ribbon as S1's smooth gold extrusion lying on the caliche with a contact shadow.

notes.problem: Top loaded per machine_qa (bottom third at 67% vs 95%). Both recording channels sit in the upper half and the lower stone is dead.
notes.fix: Spread the two channels down the stone so the second runs through the lower third, and seat the type below them.

notes.problem: The cantera carries dense scribbled stroke marks that read as a hatch texture at 432 px. The relief is shallow (height 41.8, cast 0.25), and the bottom third is a top-loaded dead zone (machine_qa 79 percent).
notes.fix: Replace the stroke normal map with a low-frequency pore-and-chisel height field. Cut the inlay channels deeper so the gold lines cast long raking shadows. Bring the second inlay down into the lower third under the dek.

notes.problem: The sieve rim is cut open at both sides and reads at thumb size as a broken model. The frame is flatter than its neighbours.
notes.fix: Close the rim, or give the cutaway a clear cut face with a shaded inner wall, and lower the raking key so the stones and grains cast long shadows on the pan.

notes.problem: The card drawer floats in a mauve and orange gradient void with no floor or room, off the deck's blue spine, and the 18 year blocks the copy promises can't be counted at feed size.
notes.fix: Stand the drawer on a lit tone sweep in the explainer blues, and raise the camera so the 18 tabbed blocks separate and can be counted.

notes.problem: The headline wash shows as a dark cloud over the sky, and the feature pills sit on the floor away from the gauges they name.
notes.fix: Seat the type in the sky's own gradient with no blotch, and anchor each pill directly under its own gauge base.
